sections.title: Transport, directions, and imperatives
body: Travel words include hållplats, station, biljett, tåg, buss and cykel.
Ask Vilken buss går till centrum? and Var ska jag stiga av?
Give two or three steps, then confirm Förstod du?

sections.title: Imperatives and sound patterns
body: Directions use the imperative without a subject: Gå! Ta bussen! Sväng! Fortsätt!
Add a landmark with vid and distance with ungefär.
In many native words g/k/sk are hard before a/o/u/å and soft before e/i/y/ä/ö; loans and accents create exceptions.

assignment.title: Episode 14 mission: Transport, directions, and imperatives
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: Where should you get off?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: What is opposite the library?

SPEAK: Give a three-step route to a library. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Explain which bus to take and where to exit. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Reverse left/right and change the landmark.

RETURN: Give one imperative and one sound pair.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Gå rakt fram. Sväng vänster vid banken. Fortsätt till biblioteket.
Writing: Ta buss fem. Stig av vid torget. Biblioteket ligger bredvid banken.

takeaways: Use: Gå rakt fram och sväng vänster vid kyrkan.
